competences.description: Attacks all enemies, recovering 50% of the damage dealt as HP. The damage of Exploit Soul increases permanently every time the skill is used.
Controls the enemy that has dealt the most damage and grants a barrier that nullifies attacks 3 times on the target each turn.
The Attack Speed of all enemies and allies is suppressed and cannot exceed a certain cap. Also, all skill effects that influence the Attack Bar will not be activated. [Automatic Effect]
